basic_profile.bio: Avid hiker and outdoors enthusiast based in the St. Louis area. I spend my weekends exploring the beautiful trails Missouri has to offer, especially during the winter months when the scenery is breathtaking and the trails are less crowded. I work as an environmental consultant, which allows me to blend my passion for nature with my profession. Married to my best friend who shares my love for the outdoors. I'm usually online in the evenings after a day spent in nature or work. I dislike crowded places and prefer the tranquility of nature.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge of local hiking trails and outdoor activities, gained from over a decade of personal hiking and environmental study. Holds a degree in Environmental Science, which complements practical experience with theoretical understanding.
